# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting on this repository when it
is enabled, or contact an SBK Techno organization owner through the private channel already in use.

Include the affected version, a reproduction, the impact, and any suggested fix. Never include a
secret, a token, or client data in the report.

## What to expect

- Acknowledgement within two business days.
- A remediation plan and a target date.
- Credit in the advisory if you want it.

## Scope






The public status page, its signed heartbeat and publish workflow, the
generated brand assets it serves, and the scripts that verify and publish them.

## Rules

- Secrets are files under `/run/secrets`, never environment variables or image layers.
- Report a leaked secret immediately so it can be rotated. Deleting the commit is not enough.
- Do not test against production without written authorization.
- Do not run a scanner, a load test, or a build on the production host.
- Telemetry cannot be disabled. If a change needs a quieter log, fix the signal, not the policy.
